_doc: Every permission difference between agents-v0.json (the original boilerplate) and the resolved agents must be listed here with a reason. The French aliases (architecte, dev, testeur) have been removed. Reviewed in Phase 8/Phase 9.

changes.reason: `opencode run --auto` approves `ask`, so unattended runs would read secrets. .env files are denied; .env.example stays readable.
Per-agent skill allowlists: only the skills an agent needs are advertised to it.
Chef starts the deterministic driver (run, status) and keeps the documented fallback commands (work next/start/gate/fail/complete) for when the driver cannot start.
